prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent injury animation sprite atlas for existing Jelly Rescue sports NPCs. Reference image is identity and costume reference only. Create ONE 1536x2048 transparent PNG atlas, EXACT grid 3 columns x4 rows, equal512x512 cells. Each cell contains ONE full-body isolated chibi character at front or shallow three-quarter view, centered at x256,768,1280. Ground/foot baseline y=490 within each row; preserve scale across animation frames, so sitting characters are visibly shorter than standing characters. Keep every sprite entirely within its cell with at least20px transparent margin. No grid lines, labels, text, scenery, shadows, effects or backgrounds. Preserve faces, hair, colors, outfit and accessories of the four referenced characters, same crisp dark navy outlines and cute illustrated miniature game style.
Row1 (y0-512): reference top-left orange basketball player. Frame1 startled stumble, torso leaning, arms out, basketball near one foot. Frame2 lowering into a squat, one knee bent, one hand supports knee. Frame3 sitting/crouching holding knee with uncomfortable closed eyes and small grimace; ball beside shoe. No serious injury.
Row2 (y512-1024): reference top-right lavender-helmet skateboarder. Frame1 off balance, arms out and one foot extended, board near foot. Frame2 kneeling down with one palm bracing ground, board alongside. Frame3 seated with one bent knee and hand holding knee, worried face, helmet still on; board beside body.
Row3 (y1024-1536): reference top-middle mint-shirt runner with mint headband. Frame1 halting run with wince and slightly bent knee. Frame2 bending forward placing hands on thighs/knee. Frame3 similar forward bent pose but one hand squeezes calf/knee with closed eyes and grimace, other hand on thigh; no ground sitting.
Row4 (y1536-2048): reference bottom-left muscular lightblue tanktop fitness man. Frame1 lowers dumbbells, slumps with wince. Frame2 puts dumbbells beside feet and braces one hand against lower back/hip with other on thigh. Frame3 slight lean with eyes closed, holding aching lower back and thigh, dumbbells on ground beside shoes.
Twelve distinct poses total, THREE frames for EACH of FOUR characters. Clothes remain identical in all frames; express mild discomfort rather than smiling. Real alpha transparency between ALL sprites. No blood, bruises, bandages, extra characters or duplicate limbs. Do not reproduce reference dark backdrop.
